biotools.summary: SpaFlow is a Nextflow pipeline for quality control and clustering of multiplex immunofluorescence (MxIF) datasets, integrating Seurat, SCIMAP, and CELESTA. It facilitates reproducible and scalable analyses with robust quality control and meta-clustering approaches.
